connector.name: Untappd
connector.registryDescription: MCP server exposing Untappd API tools for AI agents - full v4 read API coverage
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package untappd-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the darrenjrobinson account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: UNTAPPD_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Untappd OAuth access token — unlocks the friend feed tool, user-scoped rate limits, and richer /user data. Optional: can instead be obtained interactively via the authenticate_untappd tool or `npx untappd-mcp-server auth` (stored in ~/.untappd-mcp-server/token.json)

env.name: UNTAPPD_USERNAME
env.description: Default username for authenticated user tools

env.name: UNTAPPD_REDIRECT_URL
env.description: OAuth redirect URL for interactive authentication — must exactly match the Callback URL registered in your Untappd app settings; default http://localhost:8737/callback

env.name: UNTAPPD_TOKEN_PATH
env.description: Override path for the saved token file; default ~/.untappd-mcp-server/token.json
